description.value:
Normalized Heritage. This item preserves the original UUID for Human (Neanderthal) while converting it from a lineage-species into a heritage.

“Humanity is the species that keeps walking even when the map says ‘stop.’”

Human (Neanderthal). You are not a fantasy human. You are the rebooted inheritance of an older lineage resurfacing after Yesod’s fall—ancient adaptations, forgotten instincts, and survival strategies given room to matter again.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid.
  • Size. Medium.
  • Speed. 30 feet.
  • Lineage Lean. Your lineage leans toward VIO—expressed through Tier powers.

Core: Stubborn Spark

At creation you gain Stubborn Spark (Adaptive, Tenacious, Lineage Memory).

Neanderthal Tier Powers

You gain Tier I at creation, then Tier II (5), Tier III (11), Tier IV (17).

Note: This species uses placeholder ItemGrant UUIDs. Run the Human wiring macro after you store feats/species in compendiums.

advancement.title: Neanderthal Tier I
advancement.hint: Gain your Neanderthal Tier I lineage power.
